messages:
arjun: Locking announce for Thu 09:00 PT. Need final changelog permalink + canonical docs by 5pm so we can stage social and the newsroom card.

maya: Ill write the hero copy and short webinar blurb. Need a single stat we can lead with.

devon: Perf highlight: typical web p95 shows ~35% token cost reduction with adaptive batching on our test corpus. Recommend "up to 35%" on hero and link to full report.

arjun: good. devon, can you drop the perf appendix permalink? well footnote it on the blog.

devon: dropped: https://docs.redwood.ai/reports/batching-v1-3. Also created changelog draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/v1.3 (will make final release tag tonight).

ops-bot: preview deploy: https://preview.redwood.ai/releases/v1.3 ready (expires in 7 days). build#8912.

maya: grabbing screenshots from preview for social cards. lena, please confirm webinar RSVP link hooks to HubSpot.

lena: RSVP connected -> marketing@hubspot.com. Webinar set for Thu 11:00 PT. I added a short registration modal on the landing page.

arjun: canary starts Fri 09:00 PT with 10% initial traffic, rollback window 2h if p95 regresses >10%. ops command: `deployctl start --tag=v1.3 --canary=10%`.

maya: final checklist: 1) hero copy + stat (m), 2) changelog link (d), 3) docs canonical (d), 4) preview screenshots (m), 5) webinar register (l). If all green by 5pm Ill schedule the publish.

arjun: thanks team 8640; posting scheduled publish when queued.
